task: Podia (the person's own creator account): read-only walk of the logged-in site and admin so the pages, product structure and member-only views can be rebuilt elsewhere before Podia access ends. Capture only; never change, publish, delete or send anything

steps.human: Sign in to Podia in this tab. Press Done when you see your Podia dashboard.

steps.do: List every product, page, community and email sequence the dashboard shows, with its URL. Report the list in the chat before opening anything.

Open each item Jax names in the chat, one at a time, as the creator and in the customer preview. Snapshot the text and structure (sections, lessons, file names, prices shown). Do not press save, publish, delete, send or any toggle.

steps.human: If Jax asks for a file that only downloads through a button, press the download yourself, then Done.

accept: Jax has a written inventory of every product and page, plus snapshots of each member-only view the person approved, stored in the install's intake folder. Nothing in the Podia account changed.
notes: Read-only by design: every step is snapshot or navigate. No form submits.
Customer lists, orders and emails are personal data: do not open the Audience or Sales pages unless the person asks, and never snapshot them into chat.
No save_secret step: nothing here creates a credential.
